author: claude
description: Danish 'galleri-mølle' windmill. Windmill(base, upper, roof_stair, roof_cap, sail, arm, deck, rail) is 17x21x12: white terracotta lower body (radius 4) with a railed gallery deck at y6, dark oak upper body (radius 3), steep cone cap, and four pinwheel sails in the plane z=11 turning in front of a south door at (8,1,9). Inside: grindstone millstone, flour barrels, ladder through a hatch to the loft, gallery door. Floor is local y=0. build(fields=True) is a 35x22x16 farm with wheat and carrot CropPlots, hay and a glowing sign; ground_level 1.
